notes: mlas-ka-ap-tg segment: sitting members of the Karnataka (st-ka), Andhra Pradesh (st-ap) and Telangana (st-tg) Legislative Assemblies and Legislative Councils as of 2026-09-25. Assembly source: each state's live 'current members' Wikipedia table (16th Karnataka Assembly; Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly; Telangana Legislative Assembly main articles), which are kept updated in-place with by-election winners, deaths, disqualifications and defections directly in the table (either as a follow-up row for the same constituency number, or an updated Party cell) -- this was cross-checked against the state's dedicated 2023/2024 general-election-result article and, for Telangana, its explicit 'Bypolls' section, and against hand arithmetic from the original election result plus every tracked change, which reproduced the parsed party tallies exactly for all three assemblies. Legislative Council data is from each state's 'Legislative Council' Wikipedia article (Members elected by the Assembly / Local Authorities / Graduates / Teachers / Nominated by Governor tables). Karnataka: Hiriyur (MLA) and 5 of 11 Governor-nominated MLC seats are vacant/unfilled -- the nominated seats show only a placeholder 'TBD' name with party 'INC' pre-assigned in the source table; per the 'never invent a person' rule these are recorded as vacant, not held. Andhra Pradesh: no assembly by-elections found since the 2024-06-04 result; 5 Legislative Council seats are recorded vacant by the source table itself. Telangana: Khairatabad assembly seat vacant since Danam Nagender's disqualification 2024-04-23 (no by-election as of 2026-09-25); Nizamabad MLC (Local Authorities) vacant since 2026-01-06. Party-wise assembly 'stats' were computed directly from the parsed per-seat member list (not from each article's separate summary infobox, which was found to be stale/off-by-one to -two members vs. the detailed table for Karnataka and Telangana -- the detailed per-seat table's own arithmetic was verified against the original election result plus every tracked defection/death/by-election and reproduces exactly, so it was treated as ground truth over the infobox). Council 'stats' were likewise computed from the parsed per-seat table; for Andhra Pradesh this reproduced the article's own council summary table exactly (YSRCP 33, TDP 12, JSP 2, BJP 1, IND 5, Vacant 5 of 58). 'since' dates for assembly members who still hold their original 2023/2024 election-won seat (incl. those who have since defected or been expelled from their original party) are the general-election result date; for by-election winners 'since' is the by-election date; for MLCs 'since' is the term-start date given in the source table (normalized to ISO). Wikipedia URLs are only set where the member's name links to their own article in the source table (not independently verified/fetched per member, consistent with the verification bar used in the states-ka-ap-tg segment already in data/raw). Individual ministerial/office-holding remarks (Cabinet Minister, Speaker, Deputy CM, Leader of the Opposition etc.) from the source Remarks column were not carried into holder.notes to keep this segment scoped to legislature membership only -- office/ministry data is owned by the states-* / council-of-ministers segments.

method: Re-parsed JSON with python json.load to confirm it is valid JSON.

Checked entity IDs and position IDs for uniqueness (0 duplicates) and for ID-rule compliance (st-<code>-assembly / st-<code>-legislative-council entities; st-<code>-pos-mla-<slug> / st-<code>-pos-mlc-<n> positions) — 100% compliant.

Checked position count per orgId against entity.seats: Karnataka Assembly 224/224, Karnataka Legislative Council 75/75, Andhra Pradesh Assembly 175/175, Andhra Pradesh Legislative Council 58/58, Telangana Assembly 119/119, Telangana Legislative Council 40/40 — all exact matches.

Recomputed party-wise strength directly from each position's holder.party (or 'Vacant') and diffed against each entity's stats block for all 6 houses — exact match in all 6 (no correction needed to entity.stats).

Confirmed each house is the CURRENT house for the latest general election: Karnataka 16th Assembly (May 2023 election, since=2023-05-13 baseline), Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly (June 2024 election, since=2024-06-04 baseline), Telangana Legislative Assembly (Dec 2023 election, since=2023-12-03 baseline) — no newer general election has occurred for any of the three states as of 2026-09-25.

Searched (WebFetch of each state's Wikipedia assembly/council article, since this session's WebSearch quota was already exhausted by other concurrent agents) for every by-election, death, resignation, disqualification and defection 2025-2026: found and cross-checked 6 Karnataka Assembly by-elections (Shorapur 2024-06-04, Sandur/Channapatna/Shiggaon 2024-11-23, Davanagere South and Bagalkot 2026-04-09), the Hiriyur vacancy (MLA died 2026-05-10, no by-election yet), 4 Karnataka BJP-to-IND expulsions (Yatnal, Hebbar Shivaram, Somashekar) plus Latha Mallikarjun (Harapanahalli, still officially IND per the source table despite a 'Joined Congress' remark), 2 Telangana Assembly by-elections (Secunderabad Cantonment 2024-05-13, Jubilee Hills 2025-11-11), the Khairatabad vacancy (Danam Nagender disqualified 2024-04-23, no by-election yet), T. Raja Singh's 2025 resignation from BJP (Goshamahal, now IND) — every one of these was already correctly reflected in the file. No Andhra Pradesh Assembly by-elections found since the 2024 general election, consistent with the file.

Random spot-check of 30 members (seeded random.sample, python random.seed(42)) across all 6 houses against their respective current-members Wikipedia tables/articles: 30/30 name+party matches, 0 discrepancies.

Checked field completeness: 2 Karnataka MLC records (st-ka-pos-mlc-3, st-ka-pos-mlc-4 — 'Elected by the Assembly' seats 3 and 4) were missing holder.since; corrected to 2026-07-01 (term start per Karnataka Legislative Council Wikipedia page). 147/691 holders (21%) have no holder.wikipedia link and 74/691 have no holder.constituency (expected for non-geographic Legislative Council categories like 'Elected by the Assembly' / 'Nominated by the Governor') — left as-is per the segment's documented scope (not independently fetched per the original authoring notes); flagged here as a completeness gap, not a correctness error.
